paper_title: Incorporating Domain Knowledge into Materials Tokenization
caption: Comparison of Macro-F1 scores for ChemDataExtractor and MatDetector across values.
model_annotation: The line plot illustrates the Macro-F1 Score (%) as a function of the λ value for two systems: MatDetector (ours), represented by a solid pink line with circular markers, and ChemDataExtractor, shown as a dashed dark blue line with square markers. The x-axis, labeled “λ value,” spans from “w/o” (indicating no λ weighting) to 3, with tick marks at 0.1 intervals up to 1, then at 2 and 3; the scale is linear. The y-axis, labeled “Macro-F1 Score (%)”, ranges from 72.0 to 75.5, with major gridlines at 0.5% intervals. MatDetector’s score begins at approximately 72.6% (w/o), rises to a peak of 75.7% at λ = 1, then sharply declines to 72.4% at λ = 3. ChemDataExtractor’s score starts at 72.6% (w/o), fluctuates modestly between 72.3% and 73.6%, reaching a local maximum of 73.7% near λ = 1, and ends at 71.9% at λ = 3. Both lines exhibit non-monotonic behavior, with MatDetector showing greater sensitivity to λ variation, particularly the sharp peak at λ = 1.
